title: Two pet shops on Shopify POS: how do you handle supplier invoices and repricing
text: Hi! I run two independent pet shops in the UK. We use Shopify POS and Sumtracker, and buy from around 100 suppliers. Two things eat a lot of time: 1. invoices and repricing When stock arrives, we manually check each invoice line against the cost in Shopify. If a price has gone up, we work out the new retail price to hold our margin, update Shopify, tell both shops, and print new shelf labels, It’s v slow/mnaual and price rises slip through. 2. Comparing suppliers Most suppliers want orders through their portals, promotions arrive by email, website or rep, and we have to hit minimum order quantities. In practice, we often just stick with the usual supplier because comparing/optimising takes too long How do you handle these? Any tools or workflows that actually work with lots of suppliers and multiple locations, or is it spreadsheets for everyone? 5 posts - 4 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: Merchant struggling with manual supplier invoices, repricing, and multi-location sync.

title: Non-Plus B2B: how are you handling deposits or charging when you ship?
text: Since April we can use native B2B on Basic/Grow/Advanced, but deposits, partial payments and payment requests per fulfillment are still Plus-only. For those selling wholesale on non-Plus plans: Do your wholesale buyers pay upfront, on net terms, or with a deposit? If you take deposits or charge per shipment, how do you do it today (draft orders, invoices outside Shopify, an app, manually)? Roughly how much time does it take per week, and what has gone wrong (missed balances, double charges, reconciliation)? I’m a developer trying to understand whether this is a real problem before building anything. Not selling anything here. Thanks! 2 posts - 2 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: Developer researching manual wholesale deposit workflows on non-Plus plans.

title: Major Accounting Inconsistencies
text: We seek help understanding the root cause of unexpected General Ledger (GL) and Payment Ledger Entry (PLE) behaviour. We have reconciled and corrected most identified cases in one company, but have not proven why they arose or whether the common factor is standard ERPNext, custom code, deployment history, or a combination. Column 1 Column 2 Column 3 Column 4 Environment ERPNext v16 / Frappe v16, MariaDB, Docker on OVH; multiple companies/sites; several custom apps. Custom apps do not post any transaction. They are majorly reporting tools Main symptoms Repeated GL postings for one submitted invoice; active GL/PLE against Draft vouchers; cancelled vouchers retaining active ledger effects; contradictory document status. Company A scope 293 classified exceptions: 268 duplicate-GL cases plus 25 other cases (reconciled Production audit). Correction evidence 268 duplicates corrected through native Repost Accounting Ledger; 19 additional cases corrected; two cancelled-invoice PLE cases corrected. Last reported state 289/293 corrected in Production; three further methods passed UAT and were authorised for Production, but their Production result is not in the available evidence; one status-conflict invoice remains blocked. 1 What users experienced Invoices were shown as Submitted or Draft, but the ledgers did not always reflect that state. Some submitted invoices had two to four sets of accounting entries even though the PLE or customer outstanding reflected only one invoice. Other Draft transactions had posted GL entries. Some cancelled documents retained open PLE or active GL rows. As a result, GL, receivables/payables and source documents could disagree. 9 posts - 4 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: Business experiencing critical accounting inconsistencies in General Ledger entries.

title: What do you do when an estimate goes unanswered?
text: Genuine question — I've been talking to a lot of shops lately. You send the quote, hear nothing back. Do you follow up? How many times, and how — call, text, email? Or just move on to the next job? Trying to understand what actually works vs. what everyone means to do but doesn't. What's your process?
triage_reason: Contractor seeking automated workflow solutions for following up on unanswered estimates.
